description: The Collatz map can be viewed through the lens of renormalization group theory: the map from residues mod 2^k to residues mod 2^(k+1) defines a 'coarse-graining' flow. Fixed points of this flow correspond to invariant classes under the Collatz dynamics.
mathematical_formalization: RG transformation: R_k maps distributions on Z/2^k Z to Z/2^(k+1) Z via Collatz dynamics. Fixed point: mu* satisfying R_k(mu*) = mu*. Tao (2019) shows mu* is close to uniform for 'almost all' starting points.
analogical_connections: Directly analogous to Wilson's RG for the Ising model
Similar to wavelet multiresolution analysis in signal processing
Related to p-adic analysis - Collatz dynamics has natural p-adic structure for p=2,3
implementation_hypothesis: Compute the distribution of Collatz iterates modulo 2^k for k=1..20 starting from delay records. Compare with uniform distribution. Measure deviation as function of k.
experiment_seed: For each delay record, compute histogram of T^j(n) mod 2^k for all orbit steps. Measure KL divergence from uniform.
